summary_en: Nippon Shokubai approved acquisition of up to 3.0 million shares (2.0% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 6.0 billion yen through on-market purchase from November 10, 2026 to February 26, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 29, 2026, Nippon Shokubai's Board of Directors resolved to acquire treasury shares under the authority granted by the Company's Articles of Incorporation pursuant to Article 165(2) of the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 3.0 million shares (representing 2.0% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026) for a maximum aggregate consideration of 6.0 billion yen. The acquisition will be conducted through on-market purchase via a securities company on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, with the acquisition period running from November 10, 2026 through February 26, 2027.

The stated purpose is to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency, while enabling flexible capital allocation in response to changes in the business environment. As of September 30, 2026, Nippon Shokubai held 147.9 million shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock) and 2.1 million treasury shares. The maximum acquisition price per share is not specified in the disclosure.
